[[fixture-git:PersonsByEmail]]
[source,cypher,role=concept]
.Flag author nodes that share an email as having aliases.
----
MATCH (a:Author)
WITH a.email AS email, collect(a.name) AS names
WHERE size(names) > 1
MATCH (b:Author {email: email})
SET b.has_aliases = true
----

[[fixture-git:CommitsWithParents]]
[source,cypher,role=concept]
.Label commits that have a parent, as a count of HAS_PARENT edges.
----
MATCH (c:Commit)-[:HAS_PARENT]->(:Commit)
WITH c, count(*) AS parents
SET c.parent_count = parents
----

Listings without a role are examples, not rules, and are skipped:

[source,cypher]
----
MATCH (a:Author) RETURN a.email
----
